summary: Iteration 28: tested the Passenger/Driver app mode feature with backend pytest (8/8 passed) and Playwright at 390x844 on the preview URL. A fresh email registration goes to /mode ('How will you use Travoo?') with the mode-passenger and mode-driver cards. A deep link to /profile before choosing also goes back to /mode. Picking Driver shows driver-home with the 'Driver mode' badge and the driver-choose-rent and driver-choose-book cards. Book opened /hire/register?service=book: step 3 had Book preselected and the pro-book-vehicles section visible. Rent opened ?service=rent: step 3 had only Rent preselected and no vehicle section. Submitting Rent gave 'Verification pending', and Home then showed driver-registration-status instead of the choice cards. After approval through the DB, driver-open-dashboard went to /hire/driver. driver-offer-ride went to /offer, driver-carpool-verify to /driver and driver-earnings to /earnings. In the Profile 'My mode' card, switching to Passenger and back to Driver each showed a toast, redirected to /, changed Home, and stayed after reload. A fresh user who picked Passenger got the passenger home. Demo passenger and demo driver were not sent to /mode. Passenger home regression passed: Rent card goes to /hire?service=rent, Book card to /hire?service=book, Find a Ride with empty fields shows its validation message, and recent searches show. All 5 bottom tabs navigate. Logout and login work.

issues: At 390px the 'Carpool verification' button label is cut off ('Carpool veri...'). Use a shorter label like 'Verify', stack the two buttons, or allow two lines.

action_items: Optional: the seeded demo driver (driver@travoo.in, an approved local driver) has account_type='passenger', so after login it sees the passenger home, not the driver dashboard. Consider giving the demo driver account_type='driver' in the seed or a migration. Existing users from before this feature also default to passenger mode without being asked, including approved local drivers. Consider a one-time migration that sets account_type='driver' for users with an approved pro_drivers profile.
Minor: the 'Carpool verification' button label is cut off on DriverHome at mobile width.
critical_code_review_comments: hire/register.tsx load(): when a pro_drivers profile already exists, services is overwritten with p.services, so the ?service= query param is ignored. This is fine for pending or rejected users, but a user with a draft or 'none' profile who taps the other choice will not get it preselected.
In the Profile header, the badge shows the carpool driver_status ('Not submitted') even for an approved local driver in Driver mode. This may confuse users now that the mode is explicit.

Google sign-up new users get mode_chosen=false and are sent to /mode, which is consistent. Phone OTP registration passes account_type, so mode_chosen=true and those users skip /mode. Confirm this is intended.
seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST users test_iter28ui_a and test_iter28ui_b@example.com (UI) and the pytest test_iter28_* users were deleted by user_id. Demo passenger is confirmed in passenger mode at the end.
